content.short: Blink provides one-tap deposit infrastructure for onchain applications.
content.description: Blink is a one-tap deposit button that an app embeds instead of building its own on-chain deposit flow. Behind the button it handles authentication, wallet connection, on-chain transfers and cross-chain bridging, and it holds no funds itself. Web and mobile SDKs are both available: the web version renders the flow in a modal iframe, while mobile opens it in an in-app browser and returns the result through a deep link. A single prompt handed to a coding agent completes the integration end to end.
